shots.shot_intent: Put us on the floor at her height, on the last crooked tile.
shots.description: A small hand in a mustard sleeve places a wooden-look path tile slightly askew on cream carpet; the sky-blue Wobble Bot waits at the start of the path, out of focus behind
shots.action: the fingers let go of the tile and withdraw
shots.lighting: soft window light from the left, warm neutral
shots.continuity_notes: opening shot; establishes the tile path and the toy

shots.shot_intent: The stumble: the bot rolls onto the crooked tile, tips, and rights itself.
shots.description: The Wobble Bot rolls along the tile path across the carpet toward the crooked tile, weighted base catching the edge, the child's knees and mustard sleeve at the frame's edge
shots.action: the bot reaches the crooked tile, tips forward, and wobbles back upright
shots.lighting: same window light, soft shadow under the bot
shots.continuity_notes: same tile layout as shot 1; same crooked tile position

shots.shot_intent: Her stillness: the back of her head, the bot stopped on the wrong tile.
shots.description: From behind, the child sits back on her heels, short dark curls lit from the window, looking down at the sky-blue bot stopped on the crooked tile
shots.continuity_notes: bot position matches the end of shot 2

shots.shot_intent: The fix: her hand straightens the tile and the bot rolls through clean.
shots.description: A small hand nudges the crooked wooden-look tile straight; the sky-blue Wobble Bot with its amber eye sits at the tile's edge ready to roll, fingerprints on its matte body
shots.action: the hand straightens the tile and withdraws; the bot rolls across it smoothly
shots.lighting: same window light; the amber eye catches a highlight
shots.continuity_notes: same tile and bot as before; mustard sleeve visible

shots.shot_intent: Let the line land on the toy alone, finished with its path.
shots.description: The Wobble Bot at the end of its straightened tile path on cream carpet, a crumb beside it, soft shadow, the child's grey sock blurred at the top of frame
shots.action: the bot settles with a last tiny wobble
shots.continuity_notes: path is straight now; same carpet

shots.shot_intent: The parent's view from the doorway: the whole scene, small and calm.
shots.description: From a doorway, a wide view of the living room floor: the child from behind, absorbed, the tile path and the sky-blue bot small in the frame, morning light across the wooden floor and cream rug
shots.action: she leans forward to start the path again
shots.lighting: morning window light across the room
shots.continuity_notes: same room seen from further back; same clothes and toy

sequence_notes: Cuts land on line boundaries; the two motion shots carry the topple and the fix; everything else holds.
visual_through_line: one tile path on one carpet, seen from the floor
